provenance.note: District Environment Plan: Ahmednagar (2018-19, Environment Department, Government of Maharashtra and Maharashtra Pollution Control Board), which carries no water-balance table: 8 figures the plan states about water, each transcribed with the sentence it was read from and the PDF page it sits on, and 1 of its water action points. Nothing is computed from the plan; a balance is served only where the plan prints one. Review status proposed (transcribed, awaiting a reviewer's check).

conventions.figures: value and unit as the plan states them; quote is the sentence verbatim; pdfPage is the viewer's page, printedPage the number printed on it
conventions.waterBalance: null when the plan carries no NGT-template balance; the page says so rather than estimating one
conventions.review: proposed until a person reads every figure against the PDF; then verified with the date
conventions.document: sha256 and byte length of the PDF as retrieved, so a re-posted file is detected; the PDF itself is not mirrored

document.title: District Environment Plan: Ahmednagar
document.publisher: Environment Department, Government of Maharashtra and Maharashtra Pollution Control Board
document.editionNote: The label MPCB's listing gives the plans; the PDF metadata dates the file 30 December 2019 and the filename carries 23 June 2021, the date it was posted. The plan predates the district's 2024 renaming to Ahilyanagar.
document.template: CPCB model District Environment Plan under NGT O.A. 360 of 2018 (order dated 26 September 2019): a profile table and gap-and-action tables per theme. It is not the NGT water-balance template and carries no demand, supply or deficit table.
quirks: The cover page header reads 'District Environment Plan: Bhandara'; every inner page reads Ahmednagar.
The profile table prints 'Population Total: 9,41,327 [According to 2011 Census Report]' for a district whose Census 2011 population is about 45 lakh; the row is not transcribed.
The 'Sub districts' row of the profile is blank; 'Tahsils' prints 14, matching the LGD.

figures.label: Rivers counted by the water-quality section
figures.detail: 5 major rivers with 56 km in the district and 4 drains or nallas meeting them; the profile table names Godavari and Bhima.
figures.quote: There are 5 major Rivers in flowing in the district with 56km in length and 4 drains / nallas are identified meeting in to the river.

figures.label: Groundwater polluted stretches identified
figures.detail: The plan pairs this with a statement that groundwater quantity is adequate in the district.
figures.quote: There are 3 ground water polluted stretch are identified and availability of ground water quantity is adequate the district.

figures.label: Sewage generated by all ULBs
figures.detail: Fifteen ULBs; sewer network length 88 km.
figures.quote: All ULBs generates about 94.7MLD of sewage with an existing capacity of 2.8MLD of STP with Sewerage Network System Length of 88km.

figures.label: Installed STP capacity
figures.detail: One ULB of fifteen has an STP; capacity is 3% of generation by the plan's own figures.
figures.quote: All ULBs generates about 94.7MLD of sewage with an existing capacity of 2.8MLD of STP with Sewerage Network System Length of 88km.

figures.label: Sewage left untreated
figures.detail: Only 3% of generated sewage is treated; only one ULB has installed an STP.
figures.quote: However only 3% of generated sewage is being treated in the STP and about 91.9MLD sewage is left untreated. Only one ULB has installed STP.

figures.label: Population covered by the sewage network
figures.quote: It is observed that only 15% of population is covered under sewage network.

figures.label: Industrial effluent generation
figures.detail: From 564 industries, prominently agro-based, pharma and sugar distillery.
figures.quote: Industrial effluent generation is to the tune of 27.5MLD from 564 numbers of industries of prominently of "Agro Based / Pharma / Sugar Distillery".

figures.label: Industries meeting water discharge limits
figures.detail: The same sentence records 20 complaints in the last three months; MPCB closed 2 industries and imposed environmental compensation on 1.
figures.quote: 20 numbers of industries are meeting discharge limits of water standards and 20 No of complaints received or number of recurring complaints against industrial pollution in last 3 months.

actionPoints.text: Criticality-based monitoring of river bodies, with sewage network expansion and STP installation where the footprint is missing

review.extractedBy: transcribed from the PDF text and checked against the page images by the maintainer's assistant
